Commentary.Commentary: Back for the chase. Litton Das and Rony Talukdar to open for Bangladesh. Sam Curran to bowl first.
...THE CHASE...

Right then, England has posted a score of 117 runs on the board and their bowlers will have to bowl their skins out to defend this. For Bangladesh, the onus is on their batters to chase this down and win the series. Can they do it? We shall find out together. Chase coming up shortly...

Bangladesh bowlers were excellent with the ball. They ran a havoc over the England batters and never let them settle. They used eight bowlers throughout their innings. Mehidy Hasan ended his spell with 4-0-12-4 and was certainly the pick of the bowlers. Hasan Mahmud, Mustafizur Rahman, Shakib Al Hasan, and Taskin Ahmed had one in their kitty. They were excellent with their fielding as well.

It was quite a struggle with the bat on this pitch from the England side. They lost a wicket whenever a good partnership was brewing and just managed to post a below-par score of 117 runs. They will be upset with how things ended up for them. The conditions weren't easy to bat on and they will be hoping to trouble the Bangladesh batters as well in the similar way.

OUT! RUN OUT! An off-cutter, outside off, Jofra Archer swings and misses. England try to snatch a single but Jofra Archer is late to run across. An easy throw from the keeper to Rahman who takes the bails away again. England fail to get past 120.
Leg bye! Short and on middle. Rashid fails to pull and gets hit on the body. It somehow rolls to cover and a leg bye is taken.
Jofra Archer is the last batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A slower bouncer on middle, Ahmed fails to ramp it over again. Adil Rashid calls for a single but Ahmed is late to respond. Litton Das throws it to Mustafizur Rahman who removes the bails at his end.
This is excellent from Rahman! Short and on off, Ahmed fails to ramp it over.
Length and angling outside off, Ahmed looks to cut but bottom edges it to the keeper.
On middle, this is hit to square leg for one.
Adil Rashid walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A length ball on off, gets big on Duckett who pulls and gets a top edge, it just goes up in the air and Najmul Hossain Shanto runs in from mid off near the bowler's stumps and takes a diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Short and on off. Ahmed goes back and pulls but gets a top edge to the vacant mid off region. Two more.
Angles it on leg, Ahmed punches and finds cover.
Very full on middle, Duckett sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Ahmed is playing a vital cameo! Short and outside off, Ahmed skips down and goes inside out over covers.
On middle, Duckett sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Much needed! Length and outside off, Ahmed pulls it over mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Mustafizur Rahman rolls his fingers on this one, outside off, Ahmed fails to get his bat on it.
This is short and on off. Ahmed is squared up as he looks to defend but gets beaten.
Length ball, outside off. Ahmed has a poke at it but misses.
Outside off, guided to short third man.
Leg bye! Slants a length ball on the pads. Duckett fails to flick and it goes on the leg side for a single.
Rehan Ahmed walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Just look at the spell from Hasan, 4 wickets for just 12 runs. Just brilliant. Hasan drops it short and outside off, Jordon goes back to pull but fails to get some power on it. The ball goes high and to deep square leg where Rony Talukdar takes it with ease. Even 120 looks hard for England. Duckett has to play a crucial role from here.
Commentary.Howout: c Rony Talukdar b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: On top of off, Duckett punches it to long off for a single. 100 up!
Good running! This is full and outside off, Duckett works it to deep cover for a couple of runs.
On middle, Jordon hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Hasan pushes it wide of off, Jordon slaps it to cover.
Length ball, outside off, Duckett knocks it to deep point for a single.
Angles it on middle, it is played back to the bowler.
Tad short and on middle, Duckett sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and on off, Chris works to long off for one.
Outside off, Jordon cuts but finds point.
Slow in the air on off, it is pushed to cover.
An arm ball on off, this is chopped to point.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Jordon misses his sweep.
On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for one.
On middle, blocked out.
Chris Jordan is the new batter.

OUT! STUMPED! This is just too easy at the moment for the Bangla tigers. This is outside off, full and spins in. Woakes uses his feet to push but misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball lobs past him and goes behind to Litton Das who at first fails to grab it cleanly but Woakes was so far from his crease that Das had enough time to grab the ball and clip the bails off.
Commentary.Howout: st Litton Das b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: This one lands outside off and spins in sharply. Woakes keeps it out.
Chris Woakes walks in at number 7.

OUT! STUMPED! Bangladesh are just using the pitch at the most. Not giving any pace to Englishmen. Hasan goes full, slow and outside off. Curran comes down the track to heave but misses and Litton Das has simple work behind the stumps. Curran is well short as he tries to drag his bat.
Commentary.Howout: st Litton Das b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Flat and outside off, holds onto the surface. Curran slaps it to cover.
Curran takes it on the full and hits it to long on for one more.
Wide! Way outside off, Curran swings and misses.
On middle, swept behind square leg for one.
This is full and outside off, Duckett plays it to deep cover and comes back for the second.
Too full and on middle, Curran skips down and hits it to mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, cut to point for a single.
On off, kept out.
Short in length and outside off, Duckett works it to deep point for a single. 8 runs off it.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Much needed one for the English side! Length and outside off, it is cut past backward point for four.
Wide! Too short and on middle. Duckett evades and it is called as a wide.
This is good from Taskin! Full and on middle, worked to long on for one.
A slower bumper on middle. Curran keeps it out.
This is around off, Duckett strokes through covers for one.
Length and around off, Duckett blocks.
Full toss again on the pads, Duckett flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another single as Curran hits it to deep mid-wicket.
Too full and on middle, Duckett drives it to deep cover for one.
Angling on middle, drilled to long on for a single.
Fuller and outside off, this is pushed through cover for one.
FOUR! Loosener to start with! A full toss, outside off, Duckett pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, defended out.
Tossed up, outside off, Curran knocks it to point.
This one stays low, outside off and Duckett cuts it to deep point for a single.
On middle, it is punched to long on for a single.
Flat and on middle, Duckett reverse hits it past first slip and to third man for one.
Too full and on middle, eased down to long on for one.

Drinks! Bangladesh are showing yet another fightback as they are taking regular wickets. England have been poor with their shot selection and that has cost them wickets. They will hope for a score around 150 which should be par on this slow pitch.
Some extra bounce, outside off, Sam Curran fends it to backward point for one.
Another yorker, outside off, Sam Curran blocks it to mid off.
Nails a yorker, on middle, Sam Curran digs it back towards the bowler.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, Sam Curran hangs back and slices it through backward point as the ball races away from the fence.
Another one on off, Ben Duckett guides it to point for one.
Bowls it on off, Ben Duckett blocks it to the mid on fielder.
Sam Curran is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Lands it on off, Moeen Ali looks to slog sweep it but doesn't connect well. It carries towards deep mid-wicket. Shamim Hossain (sub) settles under it and takes a sitter. Moeen Ali makes his way back into the shed and England are in all sorts of trouble here.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shamim Hossain b Mehidy Hasan

Commentary.Commentary: Too full and outside off, Duckett guides it to point for one.
Lands it outside off, Duckett looks to slap it but misses.
Another one on off, Duckett blocks it back towards the bowler.
Lands it on off, Duckett blocks it to mid on.
Flighted up, on middle, Ali guides it to covers for a single.

OUT! TIMBER! That is brilliant from the youngster. Nails a yorker on leg, Jos Buttler looks to block it but gets beaten all ends up. The ball rattles over the stumps and the skipper departs for just 4 runs. England needs some good stand now! Ben Duckett is the new man in.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Buttler moves across to play a scoop but misses.
Short and on off, Buttler pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. Good fielding in the deep.
Touch fuller and outside off, Ali drives it to deep covers for a single.
On a length and on off, Ali blocks it to mid on.
Bowls it outside off, Buttler moves forward and flicks it to square leg for one.
Another one outside off, Moeen Ali pushes it but finds the man at extra covers. Ends with a dot.
Some turn and bounce, Jos Buttler drives it to extra covers for one.
Bowls it on off, Jos Buttler blocks it back towards the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Shakib Al Hasan strikes in his very first over. Slightly shorter and outside off, with some turn as well, Philip Salt looks to slap it but ends up striking it to the left of Shakib Al Hasan who takes a fine catch. Philip Salt's cameo comes to an end!
Lands it on middle, Philip Salt paddles it but finds the man at short fine leg.
Bowls it on off, Salt drills it to the left of the bowler who makes a fine stop. Dot.
SIX! Up, up and over. Touch fuller and on middle, Ali gets on his knee and slogs it over deep backward square leg for a maximum!
On a length, angling in, Salt tucks it to square leg for one.
Another one outside off, Ali works it towards mid-wicket for one again.
Full and on off, Salt turns it towards square leg for one.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! On a length and outside off, Salt picks it well and smashes it through covers. The fielder fails to collect it as it races away from the fence.
Lands it outside off, Slat punches it to the cover fielder.
Bowls it on off, Salt pushes it to mid on and scampers through for a single.
A yorker, on middle, Salt digs it to the man at mid off.
Wide! Too full and down leg, Salt looks to flick it but misses.
FOUR! Fine shot. Slightly shorter and on off, Salt picks it well and punches it through extra covers for a boundary.
Some extra bounce, outside off, Ali fends it to short covers for a quick single.
Good length, on off, Ali eases it to the mid on fielder.
On a length, angling in, Salt tucks it to mid on for one.
Lands it on middle, Salt turns it to square leg for one.
SIX! This will ease a bit of a pressure. Short and on middle, Salt swivels and pulls it over deep backward square leg as the ball sails over the ropes.
Lands it down leg, Ali misses his flick and the ball brushes his pads and rolls to the right of the keeper. A bit of a mix up there but they collect a leg bye.
Angling in from outside off, Ali fends it to mid on. This is excellent bowling from Rahman.
Another one outside off, Ali punches it but finds the man at point again.
Fuller one, outside off, Ali taps it to the man at point. Dot.
Lands it outside off, Ali punches it to point for a quick single. Good fielding!
On a length and on off, Ali blocks it to mid on.
FOUR! Lucky for Moeen Ali! Shorter and outside off, Ali looks to slap it but gets a thick top edge as the ball balloons over the slips and races away from the third man fence.
Too full and on middle, Ali digs it back towards the bowler.
Moeen Ali walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Bangladesh have an early breakthrough in the game. Lands it on a length and outside off, shaping away, Dawid Malan looks to heave it but getsa  leading edge. It goes up in the air towards third man.  Hasan Mahmud settles under it and takes a sitter. Dawid Malan makes his way back into the shed.
Commentary.Howout: c Hasan Mahmud b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and outside off, Malan looks to go for a wild swing but gets beaten.
Too full, outside off, Malan guides it towards third man for a single.
On a length and outside off, Malan plays it with soft hands as it lands safely towards the fielder at slips. Dot.
Bowls it on middle, Salt turns it to deep square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter and some extra bounce, Salt tries to loft it but gets beaten.
Lands it on off, Salt punches it to the man at mid on.
FOUR! Edgy! A On a length and outside off, shaping away a shade, Salt looks to punch it but gets a thick outside edge as it races away from the third man fence.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl now.
On a length and on middle, Malan tucks it to the mid-wicket fielder. Ends with a dot.
FOUR! Excellent from Malan. Short and on leg, Malan uses the pace of the ball and glances it through fine leg as the ball races away from the fence.
Too full, on off, Malan turns it to the man at mid-wicket.

FOUR LEG BYES! A low full toss, angling down leg, Malan looks to flick it but misses and the ball brushes his pads. It races away from the fine leg fence for a boundary! A stifled appeal, but turned down.
Good length, angling in, Salt tucks it to short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Wide! Bowls it wide outside off, swinging away further, Salt offers no stroke.
Starts with a length ball, some width on offer, Salt punches it but finds the man at point.
We are all set. The players are out in the middle. Dawid Malan and Philip Salt to open for England. Taskin Ahmed to start with the ball. Let's play...

Shakib Al Hasan says they will field first and they played really well in the last game. Adds that they will have to play good cricket as they are playing against the world champions. He says that they will give their best in this game and mentions one change in their side.

Jos Buttler says they would have bowled first but he has not much luck with the toss. Adds they want to play good cricket, they have belief and are a good side who can win. Reckons Bangladesh have given a good fight. Informs they have made one change.
England (PLAYING XI) - Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Ben Duckett, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran, Chris Woakes, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Rehan Ahmed (In for Mark Wood), Jofra Archer.

Bangladesh (PLAYING XI) - Shakib Al Hasan (C), Najmul Hossain Shanto, Rony Talukdar, Litton Das (WK), Afif Hossain, Towhid Hridoy, Mehidy Hasan (In for Shamim Hossain), Taskin Ahmed, Nasum Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Hasan Mahmud.
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and will BOWL first!

On the contrary, England were underwhelming with the bat, as they faltered in finishing their innings on a high note. They will continue to miss their first-choice middle-order batters, Harry Brook and Liam Livingstone, and the onus will be on Dawid Malan and Ben Duckett to assist the openers. Their bowlers also had a forgettable outing and they will be hoping to turn this around and take the series to the decider. Can they do it? Let's find out together. Toss and team news to follow shortly...

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd T20I as Bangladesh takes on England. The Tigers have secured an emphatic victory in the first T20I after incurring a heartbreaking 1-2 defeat in the ODI. The Tigers will focus on sustaining the momentum and winning the series. Their batting end was excellent, and their bowlers performed well too.
...Match Day...

England and Bangladesh have been big names in the cricketing circuit for a long time, but it is a surprise they have met only twice so far in the T20Is, and this is their first ever bi-lateral series. Bangladesh have played superb cricket in the white ball format on home soil, and they came back strongly after the losses in the first two ODI matches. England will look to dominate their opposition and win this match to take the series to a decider, while the home side will look to seal it with another win. The openers, Najmul Hossain Shanto and Litton Das, will be crucial for the home side, but the latter has been short of runs of late and will look to change that in this game. Their key player will be Shakib Al Hasan with his all-round abilities, as he has always stepped up for his national side with many match-winning performances. They also have some talented players like Rony Talukdar and Towhid Hridoy who will want to make an impact as well. Taskin Ahmed leads their pace attack along with Mustafizur Rahman, while Nasum Ahmed and Shakib hold the spin department. They bowled really well as a unit and will look to replicate that to get another victory. England, on the other hand, will be disappointed with the defeat in the first game. They actually started well, with both Jos Buttler and Philip Salt looking in good form, but their middle order could not capitalize and fell apart. Although Moeen Ali and Sam Curran have contributed with the ball, they will want more from them in the batting department. They were outplayed in the first T20I, which does not happen often, and they will be itching to make things right on the field. The onus will also be on Jofra Archer, Mark Wood, and Adil Rashid to put up a better show, but they also have the option of going with Rehan Ahmed if they want to go with an extra spinner in these conditions. Will they make a comeback and level the series? Or will Bangladesh seal the series? We will find out soon.
